name: SEO Rank Fixer
description: Hosted MCP server for Google Search Console and Bing data: SEO fixes ranked by the clicks they can win, site audits, index status, page scans and AI search visibility.

installation.command: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user seo-rank-fixer https://seorankfixer.com/api/mcp

examples: Ask your AI assistant: "What should I fix first on mysite.com?"

requirements.other: An MCP client with OAuth 2.1 support (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code); a free SEO Rank Fixer account

features: SEO fixes ranked by the clicks they can win, from your own Search Console data
Site audit with a health score, index status and instant page scans
AI search visibility: how ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini answer and cite you
